concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-industries-peak-season-risk-and-disputes]] — 2022-modified peak-season Protect/RevenueProtect tuning, data/role review, anomaly confirmation and dispute-notice guidance captured 2026-09-15; recommendations and dashboards do not prove risk or dispute outcomes.
warnings: Protect/Uplift and rule-tuning statements are dated provider recommendations; premium features require account configuration and added fees, and no account-specific role or eligibility is verified.
The AVS/CVC, risk-score, BIN-block and 3DS challenge suggestions are conditional and can change legitimate shopper outcomes; confirm suspected attack activity before applying an attack response.
Dispute notices, dashboards and a refund recommendation are not evidence of final fraud classification, won disputes, successful refunds, authorization or bank settlement.
